bioParagraphs.text: Shikha Kaushal has spent over 17 years helping students, professionals, children and families—through simple, powerful practices rooted in breathwork, yoga, and Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS).

With a background in science as a former Bioinformatics Research Associate and an MS graduate from the , Shikha brings together modern understanding and timeless Indian wisdom to create sessions that are both practical and deeply transformative.
